will_defaults: I will treat my wellbeing practices as required maintenance, not optional extras.
I will use the routines that keep me steady when life gets noisy.
will_not: I will not normalize habits that keep me dysregulated.
I will not wait for a crisis before taking care of myself.
I will not treat rest, sleep, and emotional regulation as negotiable.
reality_anchors: Wellness progress often begins with quieter choices repeated consistently.
